# google_vertex_ai_pipeline_job

Represents a Vertex AI PipelineJob (an instance of a machine learning pipeline).
This resource mirrors the v1beta1 PipelineJob schema from the Vertex AI REST API.

~> **Warning:** This resource is in beta, and should be used with the terraform-provider-google-beta provider.
See [Provider Versions](../guides/provider_versions.html.markdown) for more details on beta resources.

To get more information about PipelineJob, see:

* [API documentation](https://cloud.google.com/vertex-ai/docs/reference/rest/v1/projects.locations.pipelineJobs)
* How-to Guides
    * [Vertex AI Pipelines](https://cloud.google.com/vertex-ai/docs/pipelines)

## Example Usage - Vertex Ai Pipeline Job Min


```hcl
resource "google_compute_network" "vpc_net" {
  provider                = google-beta
  project                 = "my-project-name"
  name                    = "tf-test-vpc-%{random_suffix}"
  auto_create_subnetworks = false
}

resource "google_compute_subnetwork" "subnetwork" {
  provider      = google-beta
  project       = "my-project-name"
  name          = "tf-test-subnet-%{random_suffix}"
  ip_cidr_range = "10.0.0.0/24"
  region        = "us-east1"
  network       = google_compute_network.vpc_net.id
}

resource "google_compute_network_attachment" "net_attachment" {
  provider              = google-beta
  project               = "my-project-name"
  region                = "us-east1"
  name                  = "tf-test-net-att-%{random_suffix}"
  connection_preference = "ACCEPT_AUTOMATIC"
  subnetworks           = [google_compute_subnetwork.subnetwork.id]
}

resource "google_compute_global_address" "reserved_ip" {
  provider      = google-beta
  project       = "my-project-name"
  name          = "tf-test-reserved-ip-%{random_suffix}"
  purpose       = "VPC_PEERING"
  address_type  = "INTERNAL"
  prefix_length = 24
  network       = google_compute_network.vpc_net.id
}

resource "google_service_account" "pipeline_sa" {
  provider     = google-beta
  account_id   = "pipeline-owner-sa-%{random_suffix}"
  project      = "my-project-name"
  display_name = "Pipeline Owner Service Account"
}

resource "google_vertex_ai_metadata_store" "default_test" {
  provider = google-beta
  name     = "default-new-%{random_suffix}"
  project  = "my-project-name"
  region   = "us-east1"
}

resource "google_project_iam_member" "pipeline_sa_roles" {
  provider = google-beta
  project  = "my-project-name"
  role     = "roles/aiplatform.admin"
  member   = "serviceAccount:${google_service_account.pipeline_sa.email}"
}

resource "google_storage_bucket" "pipeline_output" {
  provider = google-beta
  project  = "my-project-name"
  name     = "tf-test-pipeline-output-%{random_suffix}"
  location = "US"
}

resource "google_vertex_ai_pipeline_job" "primary" {
  provider     = google-beta
  project      = "my-project-name"
  region       = "us-east1"
  display_name = "tf-test-example-pipeline-job%{random_suffix}"
  template_uri = "gs://cloud-samples-data/ai-platform/pipelines/hello-world-pipeline.json"
  
  labels = {
    env  = "test"
    tier = "ml"
  }

  network = google_compute_network.vpc_net.id

  psc_interface_config {
    network_attachment = google_compute_network_attachment.net_attachment.id
  }

  reserved_ip_ranges = [
    google_compute_global_address.reserved_ip.name
  ]

  preflight_validations = true

  runtime_config {
    gcs_output_directory = "gs://${google_storage_bucket.pipeline_output.name}/outputs/"
  }

  service_account = google_service_account.pipeline_sa.email

  depends_on = [
    google_project_iam_member.pipeline_sa_roles,
    google_vertex_ai_metadata_store.default_test,
    google_compute_network_attachment.net_attachment
  ]
}

resource "google_vertex_ai_pipeline_job" "clone" {
  provider     = google-beta
  project      = "my-project-name"
  region       = "us-east1"
  display_name = "tf-test-clone-job%{random_suffix}"

  original_pipeline_job_id = google_vertex_ai_pipeline_job.primary.id

  template_uri = "gs://cloud-samples-data/ai-platform/pipelines/hello-world-pipeline.json"

  runtime_config {
    gcs_output_directory = "gs://${google_storage_bucket.pipeline_output.name}/outputs/"
  }

  service_account = google_service_account.pipeline_sa.email

  depends_on = [
    google_vertex_ai_pipeline_job.primary
  ]
}

resource "google_vertex_ai_pipeline_job" "with_spec" {
  provider     = google-beta
  project      = "my-project-name"
  region       = "us-east1"
  display_name = "tf-test-spec-job%{random_suffix}"

  pipeline_spec = jsonencode({
    pipelineInfo = {
      name = "minimal-test-pipeline"
    }
    root = {
      dag = {
        tasks = {}
      }
    }
  })

  runtime_config {
    gcs_output_directory = "gs://${google_storage_bucket.pipeline_output.name}/outputs/"
  }

  service_account = google_service_account.pipeline_sa.email

  depends_on = [
    google_project_iam_member.pipeline_sa_roles
  ]
}
```

## Argument Reference

The following arguments are supported:


* `display_name` -
  (Required)
  The display name of the Pipeline.


* `runtime_config` -
  (Optional)
  Optional. Runtime config controlling the runtime behavior of this Extension.
  Structure is [documented below](#nested_runtime_config).

* `pipeline_spec` -
  (Optional)
  A compiled definition of a pipeline, represented as a `JSON` object. Defines the structure of the pipeline, including its components, tasks, and parameters. This specification is generated by compiling a pipeline function defined in `Python` using the `Kubeflow Pipelines SDK`.

* `psc_interface_config` -
  (Optional)
  PSC interface configuration.
  Structure is [documented below](#nested_psc_interface_config).

* `labels` -
  (Optional)
  The spec of the pipeline. Stored as free-form JSON/object.
  **Note**: This field is non-authoritative, and will only manage the labels present in your configuration.
  Please refer to the field `effective_labels` for all of the labels present on the resource.

* `service_account` -
  (Optional)
  The service account that the pipeline workload runs as.

* `network` -
  (Optional)
  The full name of the Compute Engine network to which the Pipeline Job's workload should be peered.

* `template_uri` -
  (Optional)
  A template uri from where the PipelineJob.pipeline_spec, if empty, will be downloaded. Currently, only uri from Vertex Template Registry & Gallery is supported. Reference to https://cloud.google.com/vertex-ai/docs/pipelines/create-pipeline-template.

* `reserved_ip_ranges` -
  (Optional)
  A list of names for reserved IP ranges under the VPC network.

* `preflight_validations` -
  (Optional)
  Whether to do component level validations before job creation.

* `original_pipeline_job_id` -
  (Optional)
  The original pipeline job id if this job is a rerun of a previous job.

* `region` -
  (Optional)
  The region of the PipelineJob. eg us-central1

* `project` - (Optional) The ID of the project in which the resource belongs.
    If it is not provided, the provider project is used.

* `deletion_policy` - (Optional) Whether Terraform will be prevented from destroying the resource. Defaults to DELETE.
	When a 'terraform destroy' or 'terraform apply' would delete the resource,
	the command will fail if this field is set to "PREVENT" in Terraform state.
	When set to "ABANDON", the command will remove the resource from Terraform
	management without updating or deleting the resource in the API.
	When set to "DELETE", deleting the resource is allowed.


<a name="nested_runtime_config"></a>The `runtime_config` block supports:

* `gcs_output_directory` -
  (Optional)

<a name="nested_psc_interface_config"></a>The `psc_interface_config` block supports:

* `network_attachment` -
  (Required)

## Attributes Reference

In addition to the arguments listed above, the following computed attributes are exported:

* `id` - an identifier for the resource with format `projects/{{project}}/locations/{{region}}/pipelineJobs/{{name}}`

* `name` -
  The resource name of the PipelineJob.

* `create_time` -
  Pipeline creation time (RFC3339 UTC format).

* `start_time` -
  Pipeline start time (RFC3339 UTC format).

* `end_time` -
  Pipeline end time (RFC3339 UTC format).

* `update_time` -
  Timestamp when this PipelineJob was most recently updated.

* `state` -
  The detailed state of the job.

* `schedule_name` -
  The schedule resource name if created by Schedule API.

* `satisfies_pzs` -
  Reserved for future use.

* `satisfies_pzi` -
  Reserved for future use.

* `terraform_labels` -
  The combination of labels configured directly on the resource
   and default labels configured on the provider.

* `effective_labels` -
  All of labels (key/value pairs) present on the resource in GCP, including the labels configured through Terraform, other clients and services.


## Timeouts

This resource provides the following
[Timeouts](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/plugin/sdkv2/resources/retries-and-customizable-timeouts) configuration options:

- `create` - Default is 20 minutes.
- `update` - Default is 20 minutes.
- `delete` - Default is 20 minutes.

## Import


PipelineJob can be imported using any of these accepted formats:

* `projects/{{project}}/locations/{{region}}/pipelineJobs/{{name}}`
* `{{project}}/{{region}}/{{name}}`
* `{{region}}/{{name}}`
* `{{name}}`

In Terraform v1.12.0 and later, use an [`identity` block](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/language/resources/identities) to import PipelineJob using identity values. For example:

```tf
import {
  identity = {
    name = "<-optional value->"
    region = "<-optional value->"
    project = "<-optional value->"
  }
  to = google_vertex_ai_pipeline_job.default
}
```

In Terraform v1.5.0 and later, use an [`import` block](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/language/import) to import PipelineJob using one of the formats above. For example:

```tf
import {
  id = "projects/{{project}}/locations/{{region}}/pipelineJobs/{{name}}"
  to = google_vertex_ai_pipeline_job.default
}
```

When using the [`terraform import` command](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/cli/commands/import), PipelineJob can be imported using one of the formats above. For example:

```
$ terraform import google_vertex_ai_pipeline_job.default projects/{{project}}/locations/{{region}}/pipelineJobs/{{name}}
$ terraform import google_vertex_ai_pipeline_job.default {{project}}/{{region}}/{{name}}
$ terraform import google_vertex_ai_pipeline_job.default {{region}}/{{name}}
$ terraform import google_vertex_ai_pipeline_job.default {{name}}
```
